description:
## Functional specifications
Introduce associations and separate execution-private records before strategy integration. Structurally migrate legacy messages into their original transcripts while retaining IDs/references where feasible. Preserve ratings, attachments, shares, traces and audit access. Mark legacy histories explicitly and exclude them from new automatic hydration. Test atomicity, dedupe, associations, legacy authorization and rollback safeguards before migration code.

Reuse unconsumed migrations where safe; account separately for developer/test databases that already applied earlier versions. Do not blindly replay altered migrations on populated databases.

## Files and ownership
lib/zaq/engine/conversations.ex; lib/zaq/engine/conversations/{conversation,message}.ex; new association/execution schemas as responsibility review determines; persistence tests/migrations

## Action reuse assessment
Extend Conversations and existing Message/trace persistence. Separate shared canonical data from person-bound execution details. This issue owns storage primitives; dedicated migration child owns legacy cutover.

## Tests to add before implementation / branches
Use the explicit scenarios in Functional specifications as acceptance tests; include denial, failure, concurrency and idempotency branches where applicable. Preserve existing passing assertions.

## Mocking plan
External transport/model/clock boundaries only; no blanket NodeRouter stubs.

## Documentation
docs/services/engine.md; persistence moduledocs

Execution requirements: planning only until assigned for implementation. Preserve existing uncommitted work and progress comments; do not infer completion from historical tests. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and applicable service guides before affected work. Write immediate unit/integration/property regression tests BEFORE implementation. Mock only genuine external boundaries; keep internal domain paths real. Run isolated tests and mix q per issue; final precommit belongs to the dedicated final gate. New feature E2E authoring waits for zaq-emb.12. No commit/push authorization is implied.

2026-09-26 read-only discovery: ConversationMessage currently requires conversation_id (messages table UUID PK) and MessageRating/MessageTraceArtifact FK directly to messages.id; Conversations.list_messages and get_conversation_message filter conversation_id. Preferred candidate for test-first evaluation after prerequisites: evolve Message in place (retain IDs/FKs) plus new transcript + association tables, leave legacy reads unchanged until .15 cutover. First regressions should prove one Message in two transcripts without duplicating ratings/traces, no direct ID read bypass, stable per-transcript sequence under concurrency, idempotent reattachment, no retroactive grant. Do not infer provider-level dedup scope; source key from verified ingress. No schema work has started.

Migration reconciliation evidence: this worktree’s MIX_ENV=test DB already reports 20260922000000..09 up, so new storage needs a fresh later version rather than editing/replaying those applied migrations. MIX_ENV=dev database named zaq_feature_issue_768_data_source_watch_lifecycle is absent; migration check failed with PostgreSQL 3D000, and no existing populated database was created/dropped/reset. Legacy backfill belongs .15 and should operate incrementally on preserved rows.

Beadwork forbids descendant->ancestor dependency (child .3.2 blocks parent rejected); containment and parent closure enforce that ordering. Root .3.1 is ready; .3.2 blocked. Created .3.3 child blocked by .3.2; do not close parent or unblock .14 until private schema exists. zaq-emb.15 explicitly owns legacy backfill/cutover and private execution data migration after strategy policies; .3.3 owns additive schema and no legacy data rewrites. #807 CI green, #808 pending; E2E gate unchanged.

2026-09-26 schema, authorized transcript API and separate private execution record slices landed as draft stacked PRs #807/#808/#811, children .3.1/.3.2/.3.3 closed with focused DB regression suites and mix q. Parent storage scope complete; legacy structural backfill/cutover and execution-private data migration remain explicitly owned by zaq-emb.15, not implicitly done here. Existing legacy APIs preserved, historical grants not reconstructed; PRs remain draft pending CI/review. Marking parent complete to unblock code-defined strategy .14; no E2E authored pending human UX approval.
